<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
**Verdict: The summary doesn't establish whether the candidate meets the requirement.**

- **Requirement:** 9 years of backend engineering experience.
- **Summary:** "8+ years building transactional services."

"8+" guarantees only 8 years, one short of the 9 required. The "+" could mean anything from 8 years and a few months to well over 9, so the summary neither confirms nor rules out a match. It's also slightly ambiguous whether "8+ years building transactional services" covers all of the candidate's backend experience or only part of it, which leaves room for more qualifying years.

The settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day shows relevant, substantial backend work, but it says nothing about how long the candidate has been doing it.

**To resolve:** Check the candidate's full work history (start and end dates for backend roles) or ask them directly for their total years of backend engineering experience.
